description: This file contains the implementation of the ModifyFeaturePropertiesLiveCommand class, which is an immutable class extending AbstractModifyLiveCommand and implementing ModifyFeaturePropertiesLiveCommand. It provides methods for creating instances, accessing feature ID and properties, setting headers, and generating string representations.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: Immutable implementation of ModifyFeaturePropertiesLiveCommand, extending AbstractModifyLiveCommand and providing command-specific behavior.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ModifyFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandImpl from a Command object, casting it to ModifyFeatureProperties.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID associated with this command.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the feature properties associated with this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command changes authorization; returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Provides a builder for the command's answer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
